column7: A native account claimed by an SSO login through the verified-email fallback (external_id = sso:<provider>:<sub>) was SCIM-managed under the old ExternalID != "" rule, so the SCIM token could read, edit, deactivate, delete and group-add it, native administrators included. scimManaged now excludes the sso: namespace (scimManaged, scimManagedMember, the userName-filter handler path) and ProvisionSCIMUser refuses an sso: externalId. The matrix drives every SCIM user and member-add operation x native / SSO-claimed native / SCIM-created / SCIM-created then SSO-linked; red on the old predicate (9 ssoClaimedNative cells) and on each of 9 per-operation ownership-call mutants. Core half on the real resolveSSOUser claim: TestSCIM_SSOClaimedNativeAccountIsNotSCIMManaged.
